items.new_text: Given a proposal whose evidence line points to a line of a file in one of the lead's projects, or to a journal event, followed by a quoted sentence of the lead, when the operator opens the proposals window, then the source is shown readably as project, path and line number, or as the event id, in plain text and never as a link, the quote is shown first, and when the operator countersigns a proposed line that repeats that quote it is refused as a copy, while an edited line passes and the audit record names the source in structured form but never carries the quote.
